title: Put Boxes Into The Warehouse II
description: Place boxes into a warehouse with a specific height profile to maximize the number of boxes stored, considering the warehouse can be filled from both ends.

steps.note: Pick box 4. Compare ends: warehouse[left]=1, warehouse[right]=5. 5 >= 4.
Place box 4 at right end. Decrement right pointer.
Pick box 3. Compare ends: warehouse[left]=1, warehouse[right]=4. 4 >= 3.
Place box 3 at right end. Decrement right pointer.
Pick box 2. Compare ends: warehouse[left]=1, warehouse[right]=3. 3 >= 2.
Place box 2 at right end. Decrement right pointer.
